QuestInfo.name: A Gift from Saffron
QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nTo celebrate reaching Lv #r4#k in Herbalism, #bSaffron#k has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Your hard work is being recognized. Congratulations!
QuestInfo.2: Master #bSaffron#k will have another gift for you once you reach Lv. #r10#k Herbalism. Keep up the good work!

0.0: #h0#! You're a Lv. 4 Herbalist...already? A-as your teacher, I'm so proud of you! H-here, I've put together a little something for you. Give me a second... I had it just a moment ago...\nIt's not much, but it's all I could put together on short notice. Will you accept it?

yes.0: Oh, hold on, I need a moment. Please talk to me again in a second.

no.0: Oh, y-you don't want it? Well, okay, but it'll go bad by #rJaunuary 31, 2011#k... Do come by if you change your mind!

1.0: Heehee. Think of it as a little bit of encouragement. If you reach Lv. #r10#k Herbalism, I'll give you something great...really great! Now, let's work together to become great Herbalists!
